fact: The national cybersecurity agency (ANCS) publishes a list of labelled cloud providers, version 3.3 of 20 November 2025, showing seven N-Cloud providers with labels issued in 2025 (Next Step IT, Focus Technology Solutions, Tunisie Télécom, NEOLedge, Dataxion, RFC, Ooredoo Tunisie).
title: Liste des fournisseurs Cloud labélisés
